description: Negative and contextual routing cases that keep the skill from becoming a generic writing or frontend rule.

cases.request: 把设置页的卡片间距从 16px 调成 20px，不要改任何文字。
cases.context: 任务只改样式，没有创建、修改或评审用户可见文案。
cases.rationale: 纯样式变更不需要文案守卫。

cases.request: Refactor the retry scheduler to remove duplicate database queries without changing the API response or UI.
cases.context: No rendered string, response contract, or user-facing behavior changes.
cases.rationale: Internal implementation work is outside the skill's scope.

cases.request: 补充 webhook API 文档，说明签名头、重试顺序和 HTTP 429 响应。
cases.context: 内容是开发者技术文档，不是产品界面上的可见文案。
cases.rationale: Speak Human 不默认改写技术文档或协议含义。

cases.request: Make this email to my colleague sound warmer and less formal.
cases.context: The text is interpersonal prose and is not part of a website or product interface.
cases.rationale: Generic tone editing is not UI copy guarding.

cases.request: 重构首页组件。页面文案已由法务和产品确认，必须原样保留。
cases.context: 前端组件包含用户可见文案，但用户明确禁止改写，守卫最多用于检查意外变更。
cases.rationale: 是否选择取决于代理能否以只保护、不改写的方式参与，不能把自动激活解释成改文案授权。

cases.request: Review the Candidate API status labels in the operations console for clarity.
cases.context: Candidate and API are defined product terms used by operators, but surrounding labels may contain implementation commentary.
cases.rationale: The copy is in scope, while terminology decisions require audience and product context rather than a blacklist.

cases.request: Tighten the icon-button spacing and replace its ambiguous aria-label.
cases.context: Most of the change is visual, but the accessible name is user-facing interface copy.
cases.rationale: This tests whether accessibility copy is recognized without attracting every CSS task; more observations are needed before gating.

cases.retirementReason: Merged into the better-scoped CSS-only negative case.
cases.request: 把设置页的卡片间距从 16px 调成 20px，不要改任何文字。
cases.context: 任务只改样式，没有创建、修改或评审用户可见文案。
cases.rationale: 保留为生命周期与去重追溯样例，不再参与门禁。
